implementation_notes: Node's built-in `node:test` plus an assertion library, or Vitest/Jest for ergonomics. Use Testing Library's principle: interact the way a user does. For the integration layer, run against a real server (e.g. an in-process `fetch` handler) rather than mocking fetch itself.
idiom_name: node:test / Vitest + Testing Library (user-facing queries) + real HTTP seam
pitfalls: Mocking `fetch` so the request never serialises
jsdom tests that pass while the real DOM API differs
Snapshot tests asserted on trivial output that never change meaningfully
